title: CORE Bounded Read Window v1
description: Schema for a bounded read window that records the exact bytes an agent read from a declared reference.

start_offset.description: Byte offset where the read window starts.

end_offset.description: Byte offset where the read window ends (exclusive).

bytes_read.description: Total bytes read in the window.

window_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the window content.

end_reason.description: Why the read stopped at this boundary.
